name: heldout_defaultability_v1
purpose: HELD-OUT discrimination for DEFAULTABILITY. OUT OF SAMPLE: none of these appear in real_meal_expectations_v1. H1 under test: 'the system asks when a confidently-priced PRIMARY is accompanied by an UNSPECIFIED SECONDARY component.' expected_terminal here is H1's PREDICTION, not a frozen product requirement. Calorie/protein ranges are deliberately WIDE: this corpus scores TERMINAL behaviour, and the classifier's `pass` column is NOT meaningful for it.
falsification: A and B do not separate (both ask, or both log) -> H1 is DEAD; the rule is not about secondary specification.
109 asks -> the driver is COMPONENT COUNT, not specification.
110 asks -> the driver is ANY unspecified quantity, not secondary-ness.
112 asks -> specification is not the driver at all.
